needs: commands.test set to "npm test" in .factory/sandbox/manifest.json, so the tests gate runs the suite this PR adds and the coverage gate has a coverage/lcov.info to read. The manifest's capabilities.not_exercised entry "Automated tests and total coverage" (paths: src/) should also be removed once it is, because it is no longer true.
why: The repo had no test runner, so setup recorded commands.test as null and the manifest is frozen and protected (policy paths.protected lists .factory/sandbox/**), which this gardening pipeline may not change. This PR adds the runner the manifest predicted would arrive: node's built-in test runner, driven by a new `test` script in package.json, needing no new dependency, so `npm ci` picks it up with no other amendment. Run here it is 48 tests, all passing, 98.04% line coverage of src/ (server.js lines 18-21, the `require.main === module` listen guard, are the only uncovered lines by design). Until commands.test is set, bsf gates tests still reports `no_tests`/neutral and the coverage gate still finds no report, so the suite is written but the gates stay blind to it.
